title: Endmarker-list shadowing in Dedicated routing causes customer-specific semantic shifts during evals
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Summary: Two enterprise customers reported sudden semantic shifts in eval outputs after the 1.22 rollout of a routing-layer config simplification. Their canonical prompt suites started returning longer completions that included extraneous clause fragments; automated evals showed a 20-30% regression on exact-match and scoring metrics. This ticket tracks investigation and a staged remediation for a configuration shadowing bug affecting endmarker (termination phrase) lists in Dedicated routing pools.

Scope: Hosted unaffected; Dedicated pools and Private deployments using the routing config rewrite path are at risk when per-customer endmarker lists are present. The problem is deterministic for affected customers and reproducible with the attached minimal repro harness.

Why this is urgent: Customers use the endmarker lists to enforce legal or formatting cutoffs. Regression impacted their CI-based eval gating and caused a partial outage in downstream batch processing for AcmeLegal. We have an open SEV and legal review request from FinSight due to data-processing requirements.
steps_to_repro: 1) Checkout routing v2 feature-branch referenced in related_prs
2) Deploy a Dedicated pool with routing config that includes both global endmarker list and a per-customer endmarker override (see attached config snippet)
3) Run the provided minimal eval harness against model 'redwood-clarity-v1' with temperature=0.0 and sampling defaults applied by runtime
4) Observe that per-customer endmarker list is not applied consistently: some requests use the merged list, others only the global list leading to longer completion windows
5) Compare outputs to pre-1.22 baseline to reproduce exact-match regression
root_cause: During the routing config rewrite (runtime-1.22), we changed how per-request termination lists are merged. A refactor introduced a shallow-copy path in the router that caused the per-customer endmarker list to be overwritten by a later normalization pass when the request traversed the Dedicated pool routing node. In short: config shadowing in the rewrite path causes loss of per-customer endmarkers for a subset of request paths. The sampling defaults change uncovered the issue because without explicit stop enforcement, generation continued until model-internal heuristics terminated the sequence, producing the observed semantic shifts.
workaround: Short term: Add an explicit stop token in the prompt content for affected customers (PR template in attachments) or pin routing to the legacy merge path (roll back routing rewrite for affected Dedicated pools). Ops can patch pools using 'rdwctl routing-set --merge-mode legacy' until fix is deployed.
fix_plan: Hotfix: restore defensive deep-merge of endmarker lists in routing rewrite (one-day patch, rollout to Dedicated only)
Unit/e2e: add tests that exercise per-customer endmarker merge semantics and sampling-default interplay
Canary: rollout to 10% of Dedicated pools for 24h with automated metric checks (exact-match, mean token length, terminated-by-endmarker ratio)
Full rollout: once canary stable for 48h, promote to 100% Dedicated, then ship to Private deployment docs and provide migration note
testing_plan: Add parametrized unit tests for merge path, add integration test in our harness that runs customer prompt suite against canary Dedicated pool, include sampling-defaults matrix (temperature: 0.0, 0.2, 0.7). Update runtime acceptance gating to assert 'terminated-by-endmarker' > 99% for configured endmarker sets.
timeline: 2026-03-08: SEV opened by CSM; 2026-03-09: initial repro and root-cause linked; 2026-03-11: workaround communicated to customers and ops; 2026-03-13: hotfix branch opened; 2026-03-14: canary deploy scheduled
next_steps: Finalize hotfix PR and tag for runtime-1.22.1 (owner: Luca)
Coordinate canary window with SRE and customers listed in customers_impacted (owner: Maya)
Prepare customer communication draft and runbook for SEV closure (owner: Sarah - CSM)
Add postmortem stub and link incident_id when SEV is resolved
notes: This bug only surfaced after we tightened sampling defaults in runtime: when sampling was more permissive, endmarkers were effectively enforced by early termination probability; the stricter defaults made the missing endmarker lists visible.
Private deployments that did not adopt the rewrite path are currently safe but should be validated before upgrading to runtime-1.22
Consider adding a lint to the config validator that flags per-customer lists when merge-mode=shallow
